method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, version in force from 9 March 2025 (registers/source-bundle/IA1966.txt)
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run ia-cases-life-policy.l4 ; l4 run ia-cases-nominations.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the policy owner: ss 131-133 (relevant policy; trust and revocable nominations, creditors, revocation consents, deemed revocation, redistribution on a nominee's death, where death benefits go), s 146 (insurable interest and the cap on recovery), s 147 (capacity of a young person), s 148 (deductions), s 149 (surrender, non-lapse and paid-up rights after 3 years) and s 150(2), (7)-(13) (payment without probate, proper claimants, sharing the prescribed amount). Not encoded: licensing, supervision, control, intermediaries, winding up, offences, administration; s 132(9)-(15), ss 134-136, s 150(1), (3)-(6), ss 151-152. Prescribed amounts and manners are inputs (not deposited).
